CustomField.formula: IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Total_Logged_In_Seconds__c)) && Total_Logged_In_Seconds__c > 0, TEXT(FLOOR(Total_Logged_In_Seconds__c / 3600)) & " hour" & IF(FLOOR(Total_Logged_In_Seconds__c / 3600) != 1, "s", "") & " " & TEXT(FLOOR(MOD(Total_Logged_In_Seconds__c, 3600) / 60)) & " minute" & IF(FLOOR(MOD(Total_Logged_In_Seconds__c, 3600) / 60) != 1, "s", "") & " " & TEXT(MOD(Total_Logged_In_Seconds__c, 60)) & " second" & IF(MOD(Total_Logged_In_Seconds__c, 60) != 1, "s", ""), "" )
CustomField.label: Total Logged-In Hours
